A Profile resource is a named set of ACLs that Console and User resources refer to, so several consoles share one definition of what they may do.

## Examples

**An operator profile**

```text
Profile {
  Name = operator
  Description = "Run and watch backups, restore to /tmp"
  Job ACL = *all*
  Client ACL = *all*
  Storage ACL = *all*
  Schedule ACL = *all*
  Pool ACL = *all*
  File Set ACL = *all*
  Catalog ACL = *all*
  Command ACL = status, list, llist, run, rerun, cancel, restore, messages, show, .api, .help, .jobs, .clients, .storages, .pools, .filesets, .bvfs_*
  Where ACL = /tmp/bareos-restores
}
```

### Name {#d-name}

Key: `name` · Type: name · Required

Name of the profile; Console and User resources refer to it with Profile.

```text
Profile {
  Name = "operator"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add profile name=operator
```

### Description {#d-description}

Key: `description` · Type: string

Free text describing what the profile is for.

```text
Profile {
  Name = operator
  Description = "Run and watch backups"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add profile name=operator description="Run and watch backups"
```

### Job ACL {#d-jobacl}

Key: `jobacl` · Type: ACL list

Which jobs this profile may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
Profile {
  Name = operator
  Job ACL = backup-web, restore-files
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add profile name=operator jobacl="backup-web, restore-files"
```

### Command ACL {#d-commandacl}

Key: `commandacl` · Type: ACL list

Which console commands this profile may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. A console that may use restore needs the dot commands the restore uses as well (for the GUI: .api, .help, .bvfs\_\* or .ovfs\_\*). On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
Profile {
  Name = operator
  Command ACL = status, list, llist, restore, .api, .help
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add profile name=operator commandacl="status, list, llist, restore, .api, .help"
```

### Catalog ACL {#d-catalogacl}

Key: `catalogacl` · Type: ACL list

Which catalogs this profile may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. A console that may use no catalog cannot list jobs or volumes. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
Profile {
  Name = operator
  Catalog ACL = MyCatalog
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add profile name=operator catalogacl=MyCatalog
```

### Where ACL {#d-whereacl}

Key: `whereacl` · Type: ACL list

Which restore target paths (the where= of a restore) this profile may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. An empty list forbids every where= other than the job's own; \*all\* allows any path. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
Profile {
  Name = operator
  Where ACL = /tmp/bareos-restores
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add profile name=operator whereacl=/tmp/bareos-restores
```

### Plugin Options ACL {#d-pluginoptionsacl}

Key: `pluginoptionsacl` · Type: ACL list

Which plugin option strings a job may be started with this profile may use. The list holds names or regular expressions, separated by commas or given by repeating the directive; the first matching entry decides, an entry starting with ! forbids, \*all\* allows everything, and a name no entry matches is forbidden. On the Onesimus Director the catalog ACL (.acl) can narrow this list further, never widen it.

```text
Profile {
  Name = operator
  Plugin Options ACL = python:module_name=bareos-fd-local-fileset
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add profile name=operator pluginoptionsacl=python:module_name=bareos-fd-local-fileset
```
